snippet.title: Wake Up – Official Game Trailer | Coming Soon on Steam
snippet.description:
Wake Up is a mysterious 2D point-and-click puzzle game created by R16 Studio. 
You will enter a world of dark corridors, locked doors, and sinister secrets, 
where every decision matters.

Coming Soon on Steam.
